profile.name: Ronak Jagad
profile.title: Frontend & Full-Stack Developer • Digital Marketer
profile.subtitle: Bridging clean, modern engineering with data-driven growth. Specializing in responsive React web applications, business websites, technical SEO, and marketing automation workflows.
profile.status: Available for Full-time Roles, Internships & Freelance Projects
profile.aboutBio: I am Ronak Jagad, a developer and growth marketer based in Mumbai. Having a multidisciplinary background bridging commercial business acumen (B.Com) and technical development training at Grow Skills Academy, I bring a unique dual edge: I write clean, maintainable frontend & backend code while understanding SEO, conversion funnels, and organic marketing that actually drives measurable traffic and leads.

highlights.title: Full-Stack & Frontend Development
highlights.description: Proficient in React.js, modern JavaScript (ES6+), responsive Tailwind CSS/Bootstrap, PHP, and MySQL. Focused on accessible, component-driven, high-performance interfaces.

highlights.title: Digital Marketing & Technical SEO
highlights.description: Hands-on experience in on-page/technical SEO audits, organic keyword research, Google Ads campaigns, analytics tracking, and conversion-focused landing page design.

highlights.title: Workflow & Marketing Automation
highlights.description: Building automated lead routing pipelines, CRM syncing, webhook integrations, and process automations utilizing n8n, Python, and RESTful APIs.

projects.title: Tvaaraa Cosmeceuticx
projects.tagline: Modern cosmeceuticals & skincare brand portal built for credibility, conversions, and organic search.
projects.description: Production brand website and product showcase designed for Tvaaraa Cosmeceuticx. Features structured product catalogs, responsive customer inquiry funnels, brand storytelling, and technical SEO architecture to drive organic discovery.
projects.details: Engineered mobile-first responsive layouts, structured product catalog presentation, integrated contact & lead capture points, and optimized meta descriptions, Schema tags, and Core Web Vitals for search rankings.

projects.title: Securex Earthing
projects.tagline: Industrial electrical safety & earthing solutions website with high-converting inquiry funnels.
projects.description: Commercial web portal developed for Securex Earthing to showcase industrial electrical protection systems, chemical earthing electrodes, lightning protection equipment, and facilitate direct B2B inquiries.
projects.details: Architected product specification tables, downloadable catalog access, WhatsApp direct inquiry integration, structured schema markup for local and industrial search terms, and cross-browser compatibility.

projects.title: Shashwat Foundation Rajkot
projects.tagline: Non-profit organization platform dedicated to social welfare, community drives, and transparency.
projects.description: Official online portal for Shashwat Foundation (Rajkot), built to communicate the NGO's mission, showcase community drives and health camps, display event galleries, and connect volunteers and donors seamlessly.
projects.details: Crafted an empathetic, accessible visual layout with responsive photo galleries, event archives, donation/volunteer inquiry channels, and fast load speeds across mobile networks in regional areas.

projects.title: AI-Based Scholarship Finder
projects.tagline: Intelligent eligibility matching system connecting students with educational funding opportunities.
projects.description: A smart web application designed to solve the friction students face when discovering eligible scholarships. Analyzes academic credentials, category, and eligibility parameters to recommend personalized scholarship matches.
projects.details: Engineered dynamic filtering algorithms based on student profiles, eligibility criteria, and deadlines. Designed an intuitive dashboard to search, track, and monitor scholarship application progress.

projects.title: Calculator Hub Suite
projects.tagline: Interactive suite of real-time utility, financial, and fitness calculation tools.
projects.description: A responsive, single-page suite of essential everyday calculators (Financial EMI, BMI Health, Percentage, Age, and Scientific Arithmetic) built with a zero-dependency vanilla JS engine for instant execution.
projects.details: Constructed accurate formula algorithms with strict edge-case input validation, tactile interactive keypad controls, keyboard accessibility, and instant calculation state feedback.

timeline.title: Full-Stack Developer & Digital Marketer
timeline.description: Delivering commercial client websites including Tvaaraa Cosmeceuticx, Securex Earthing, and Shashwat Foundation. Implementing technical SEO, conversion funnels, n8n automations, and modern React web applications.

timeline.description: Received rigorous practical training in on-page and off-page SEO, site performance auditing, keyword search intent mapping, paid campaign architecture (Google Ads, Meta Ads), and conversion rate optimization principles.

timeline.title: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com)
